CurrentSourceReview: Ordinary worker-only programs are retained. Adult queens can enroll in dedicated or explicitly integrated care without being cast as workers.
Explicit setup admits a physiological adult queen with social and long-term config. Care context does not model mating or activate reproduction.
An enabled reproduction wake attempts at the configured interval and re-arms after either success or deferral until death.
Funding debits maternal crop protein, hydration and body energy, and distinguishes offspring energy export from reproductive dissipation.
Runtime uses the configured maintenance horizon, basal energy rate and water remainder. Two days is a fixture choice, not a mandatory runtime constant.
A deferred attempt allocates no child and spends no egg funding, but it is a real attempt fact and normal time synchronization still applies. A funded child is a Worker Egg.
Dynamic offspring copy maternal physiology config except adult protein target. Preconfigured individuals may independently override rates.
Piecewise-constant depletion uses exact elapsed time and can schedule terminal depletion before an uptake wake.
Same configured basal rate across living stages of an individual. Adult Nurse/Forage/Excavate drive the extra rate. Timed queen care has no independent activity-rate branch.
Only Larva and Adult assimilate carbohydrate/water at pulses. Exhaustion is tested after time settlement, before assimilation.
Carbohydrate use is limited by energy room and pulse allowance, water by hydration room, and only larval assimilation increases tissue protein.
Egg development advances without feeding. Larval developmental time counts only after the configured tissue-protein threshold, with no instar state.
Larva and Pupa advance on configured development durations once eligible. The 2/3/2-day numbers belong to fixtures. No thermal or humidity dependence.
Stage changes keep EntityId. Adult enrollment can schedule autonomy, and stage change also interrupts invalid care custody.
Death removes active care, contact, physiology, locomotion programs and reproduction as applicable. Stores are retained in the corpse or material ledger.
The regular bounded sampler defaults to budget 16 across 27 bucket positions. Care uses a different enumeration. Unbounded social ablation also exists.
Location, load and dwell still gate worker switching. Ordinary wakes coexist with a care lease. Integrated adult queens have a separate branch.
Deficit signal reads exact stores on reachable sampled neighbors. It does not use a global need ledger.
Physically accessible depot stock may contribute from contact. Actual foraging enrollment also requires the exact depot and admissible surface/connector steps.
The quarter reserve gate remains in ordinary urgency. Care uses a distinct same-threshold capability check and separate contact memory.
Compatible current local need and carried crop can retain an existing Nurse under continuation. This does not create a promised or successful transfer.
Four ordinary weighted candidates remain. Timed integration adds an independently eligible fifth choice that leases care motor at Nurse weight.
A real eligible depot return can replace the policy wake with a return-marked wake one millisecond later under long-term mode.
Ordinary nutrient wake selects gifts only in Nurse, with configured urgency/ordering. Explicit dedicated Feed is a distinct source of a validated trophallaxis request.
Ordinary donors use uniform reservoir selection after candidate sampling and receiver filtering, not uniform global recipient choice.
Live sender/recipient, matching colony and exact reach/clearance/stock checks remain. Continuous and mixed geometry refine the spatial contract.
Gift-first checks self urgency. Otherwise cargo/depot intake is half-crop gated, with Rest protein return also able to take precedence when enabled.
Demand-sensitive depot withdrawal uses componentwise maxima from bounded accessible recipients and own demand, not colony-wide totals.
Optional post-intake contact shortcut only follows an actual NestIngested result for Nurse and uses the next millisecond.
Rest with the recycling option returns transferable crop protein to the local depot. Tissue protein is excluded.
Queen can receive real gifts and can act in caste-specific local care, including an eligible feeding request. No general queen solicitation policy was added.
Energy accounting remains program-based. Observation now separately reports known timed activity, inactive care and unknown activity.
First foraging enrollment starts with an eligible adult worker at its known depot and no conflicting actions, including an optional locally found underground connector.
Configured cell-radius BFS and cardinal trail cues remain. Continuous positions and geometry add actual segment checks and scope surface sensing to the surface.
Cargo, at-home/away state and bounded trip gates drive return/delivery. Mixed worlds use remembered connector positions to reach the actual depot.
Normal return follows its private trace. Mixed-world connector steps are also validated, with no generic blocked-path replanning.
Nearest reachable local food wins. Equal graph-distance candidates are ordered by cell and drawn from private RNG. No nutritional preference calculation.
Local collection is capacity- and supply-limited with deterministic competition. Successful committed food can establish return memory, including exact local target contact under R1.
Applicable memory is preferred ahead of trails after local food. Expiry and invalid learned successor/endpoint are checked. Five minutes is the default lifetime.
Exclude the predecessor with alternative steps unless it is the sole visible cue and the trail weight is active. This is a narrow local correction.
Visited base 1 is hardcoded. Other named values are configurable weights. Decayed capped trail fraction contributes within a private weighted choice.
FollowTrail label depends on chosen cue visibility, not whether removing the cue changes the counterfactual draw.
Only successful loaded surface moves deposit at destination under trails_enabled. Dose and cap are configured, not measured chemical quantities.
Sparse abstract field uses exponential half-life, cutoff and periodic maintenance. Reading computes current value without consuming simulation time or RNG.
Same-boundary foraging choices are made before their action submissions. Finite surface and connector state are restored with the queue.
Optional space demand compares bounded reachable site count against local contact count times a configured target. This is not chamber capacity measurement.
One local six-face slab is selected from reachable no-rock candidate cuts while away from depot and unloaded.
Exploration uses maximum Manhattan distance among local portals. At finite path capacity it backtracks.
Autonomous workers reverse their trace and drop. Explicit Fill uses material from held parcel and invalidates geometry-derived reach, including active care validation.
Actual dig volume determines material and energy costs. Load, material, local face and envelope constraints are rechecked at commit.
Finite reserves were introduced at setup and then released by source schedule. The one-day/15-day values are configured defaults, with no endogenous environmental regeneration.
Care now stores temperature/humidity labels. They do not enter physiological, behavioral or seasonal rate equations.
Transaction and phase watermark remain. Current care, connector and durable history formats preserve identity and simulation boundary semantics.
Additional distinct care opportunities, selection, actual begin/end, duration flags and targeted inspection exist. History and summaries remain observational.
Loaded/unloaded cubic extents persist. Continuous clearance can reject real surface barriers even without underground geometry. Carried brood adds explicit swept load and grip checks.
General neighborhood still exposes distance and clearance candidates, including possible dead IDs. Care and social filter live/stage/colony, with different indexed or fallback paths.
Read-only A* takes an explicit goal. Autonomous foraging uses a bounded locally discovered connector, and excavation uses local portals rather than A*.
Ordered edits remain authority and caches derived. Current persistence preserves the physical geometry state and facts.
Same-boundary claims retain deterministic actor/resource ordering and one ordinary resolution per actor. Distance-cue tie draw is a separate mechanism.
Integer proportional food portions with deterministic component remainder apply to physical mass. Collection stops at room and availability.
Worker-only ordinary resolution remains. Caste-specific care and reproduction have separate guards and events, so the worker restriction is not universal.
Explicit lifecycle scheduling remains a fixture route. Physiological progression and dynamically born individuals retain stable IDs and invalidate incompatible care.
Food priority, bounded trace memory, sole-cue correction and trail cutoff persist. Mixed continuous connectors use physical positions for actual access.
No cut at depot in the autonomous motor, finite 64-waypoint path and drop at origin under actual ownership.
Return marker and urgent depot work remain, with new integrated queen and care-lease priority branches.
Bounded social Floyd ranks are selected before invalid targets are removed. Commit validates actual contact. Dedicated care opportunities are not this sample.
Integer remainders, depletion deadlines and tissue-gated larval clock remain. There is no temperature multiplier or instar risk.
Source config controls finite pulses and optional alternation. Released quantity is an exact ingredient debit/credit, including possible zero release.
Normal Nurse gift and Rest intake/recycling remain. Dedicated or leased care can attempt real larval nutrition, with independent observation and contact constraints.
Private per-actor draws remain. 1048576 integer precision multiplier is used only for a response-bearing trail draw and is numerical.
